instrumentDefectsFoundByViolation: THE PLATE RULE WAS BLINDED BY ITS OWN EXCLUSION SET, and it is the strongest rule on this lens. The candidate regex could span separators; the rule then excluded a whole candidate if any run inside it matched a declared composer format. A plate next to a record id joined into one candidate, the record id excluded it, and 'FIX-CAM-1007 7XYZ123' passed. An exclusion whose scope is wider than its claim. Fixed by removing the composer's own identifiers as EXACT STRINGS first and matching plate forms against the remainder; four self-tests added.

THE BADGE RULE WAS SCOPED TO THE LENS BODY AND THE NAV IS OUTSIDE IT. An invented state word in the sidebar was on the canvas and unchecked. Badges, surveillance terms, plates, money and vendor names now read the whole document; two self-tests added. Neither defect was visible from reading the file; both were found by planting a defect and watching the check not fire.

findings: A REQUIRED FIELD IS MISSING FROM THE LIVE PATH AND NOTHING FAILS. RECORD_SHAPES.spireon declares operatorRef required:true. It occurs ZERO times in src/vendor-live.mjs (counted, not inferred) and assertRecordShape occurs ZERO times there against the fixture seam's two. The grouping dimension the patrol roster is built on does not survive the cutover, and on bastrop_tx the cutover has already happened because the server routes that region to the live composer.

THE SPIREON SHAPE DECLARES NO FIELD IT WILL NEVER CARRY. samsara declares operatorName required:false with a basis, verkada declares three, firstdue declares crew. spireon declares none. The refusal that keeps a person out of the patrol roster lives only on the generated record, which the live mapper does not produce. The module's own words: a guard catches the attempt and a contract prevents it. On this one shape there is no contract.

THREE OF THE SIX SHIPPED PATROL COLUMNS CANNOT BE FILLED BY THE GENERATOR. web/index.html declares Unit, Status, Operator, NSpire, Maintenance, Recent Alerts; activeInNspire, maintenanceAlertCount and recentAlertCount exist only on the live mapper. Same class as the Completion column Public works found on the CIP table, three times over. On a granted demo pack they render blank and a blank alert cell reads as none.

granted-empty IS UNREACHABLE ON THIS LENS THROUGH THE SEAM. CAMERA_FIXTURE_PLAN and PATROL_FIXTURE_PLAN each return a fixed non-empty set, so composeDomain can never take the zero-record branch. The lens the product built to prove it can tell ungranted from granted-empty cannot currently produce granted-empty. It is reachable only through the live read, which has its own differently worded sentence in okResult. The boards quote the template with its slots rather than inventing a filled-in sentence.

THE PRODUCT'S OWN MONEY GATE REFUSES TWO OF THE PRODUCT'S OWN NOTATIONS. FORBIDDEN_CONTENT matches any currency symbol anywhere, so a template literal's slot and a regex's end anchor both trip it. Quoting a sentence template or a declared format character for character would put a money token on a lens that prints none. Resolved by rewriting the notation and saying so on the page, not by widening the rule; check.mjs applies the same transform to the source string so the comparison stays two-sided. Found by check.mjs, not by reading the board.

THE COUNTING RULE FOR AN ABSENCE IS ITS BASIS WITH A PREFIX. Verified for all four absences this design draws: countingRule equals 'no records: ' + basis exactly. Printing both is printing one sentence twice. gen.mjs asserts the identity so the board's sentence breaks if the seam changes.

ONE OPERATOR NAMESPACE, TWO LENSES, AND NOTHING SAYS WHETHER IT IS ONE PERSON. fleet-vehicles.mjs and patrol-vehicles.mjs each declare the same two-digit OPR format and the byte-identical OPERATOR_BASIS string, neither importing the other. Fleet mints OPR-01 to OPR-04, Police mints OPR-01 to OPR-03, on one pack. Reported by the Fleet lane's close and RE-VERIFIED at source here rather than accepted from that artifact. Two lenses answering one constraint the same way is still right; sharing an opaque namespace without saying so is not.

EMERGENCY EOC IS HOMED TO TWO LENSES AND NAMED ON NEITHER. SHELL_HOMES homes it to 'Police + Fire and EMS'; the shipped Police not-built panel names Incident log and Regional operations map, the Fire panel names four others, and neither names Emergency EOC. The Patrol board draws the two the Police lens itself names, and this is raised rather than silently added.

THE SHELL-HOMES DISPOSITION FOR POLICE AND CAMERAS STILL READS 'Not built' WHILE BOTH ARE REGISTERED DOMAINS. ALREADY RECORDED, not a new finding: src/lens-claims.test.mjs states that seven lens-granular rows across Fleet, Police, Fire and EMS and Public works look stale in the same way and are routed rather than edited, because those rows map to no domain without a ruling. Named so the Police pair is identified, not to re-open it.

THE GENERATOR PRINTS 'unit unit'. PATROL_VOCABULARY carries entries already ending in the word unit and the label template appends ' unit NN', so probe-city renders 'Traffic unit unit 23'. UNIT_LABEL_FORMAT permits it. Cosmetic, visible on any granted pack, and the board renders it as the composer produced it rather than tidying data on a canvas.

falsifier: If the design were wrong, the most likely shape would be: the boards render the three distances from data as three degrees of one empty state, so a reader cannot tell a withheld grant from an un-onboarded vendor from a deliberate refusal; or a figure, a vendor name, a state word or a record id on a board does not trace to the product at f776b4bf; or a plate-shaped string or a surveillance term reaches the canvas outside a declared refusal. Pre-registered before the final check run. Each has an instrument: the three distances are drawn in three different tones with three different obstacle-kind sentences and each is carried by its own blocked card or refused-class panel; every figure is checked against the set of numbers the composer produced at ANY font weight; every vendor name in prose is checked against this lens's own gates after source quotations are lifted out; every state word is checked against the shipped vocabulary across the whole document including the nav; every record id is checked in composer order; and the plate and surveillance rules were each verified by planting a violation and watching the check fail.
contradicted: THREE THINGS THIS LANE EXPECTED AND FOUND OTHERWISE. (1) CP1 planned THREE boards. Rendering showed the occupancy matrix and the three refused classes could not share a sidebar with an 18-row register, and the honest reading was not that the layout was wrong but that two arguments were sharing a board; the refusals became their own board because refusing occupancyCount is what MAKES the band vocabulary, so the matrix and the refused fields are one argument. Four boards, with a fifth considered and cut. (2) THE CHECK'S STRONGEST RULE DID NOT WORK when it was first run against a real violation. A plate beside a record id passed, because the exclusion set was wider than its claim; and an invented state word in the nav passed, because the read was scoped to the lens body. Both were found by violating the check, not by reading it, and both are self-tests now. Reading the instrument would not have found either. (3) THE MONEY RULE AND THE VERBATIM RULE CONTRADICTED EACH OTHER. Quoting the product's own sentence templates character for character puts a currency symbol on a lens that prints none. The resolution was to rewrite the notation and say so, not to widen the money rule to admit a known bad value.
